FRLS.description: Beam End Release (FRLS). Keyed by element number; each element carries an ITEMS array where every entry defines the i-end/j-end release flags and partial-fixity spring values for one boundary-group release condition.

ITEMS.description: Array of beam end release conditions applied to the element. Each item is a distinct release condition (optionally tied to a boundary group via GROUP_NAME).

ID.description: Serial number of this release condition within the element. If it matches an existing condition it is updated; otherwise a new serial is used. Default 0 (auto).

GROUP_NAME.description: Boundary Group name this release condition belongs to. Empty means no group. If non-empty it must reference an existing boundary group (hard-validated on set).

bVALUE.description: Input method for the release. false = Relative release (release flag only); true = Value (partial fixity spring values in VALUE_I/VALUE_J are used).

FLAG_I.description: Release flags for the i-node, a string of exactly 7 characters ordered [Fx, Fy, Fz, Mx, My, Mz, Mb]. Each character marks whether that DOF is released. Length must be exactly 7 (hard-validated).

VALUE_I.description: Partial fixity spring values for the i-node, ordered [Fx, Fy, Fz, Mx, My, Mz, Mb]. Used when bVALUE is true.

FLAG_J.description: Release flags for the j-node, a string of exactly 7 characters ordered [Fx, Fy, Fz, Mx, My, Mz, Mb]. Each character marks whether that DOF is released. Length must be exactly 7 (hard-validated).

VALUE_J.description: Partial fixity spring values for the j-node, ordered [Fx, Fy, Fz, Mx, My, Mz, Mb]. Used when bVALUE is true.
